eventDetail.scope: The International Symposium on Medical Information Processing and Analysis (SIPAIM) focuses on advances in the processing, analysis, and interpretation of medical information, including medical imaging, biomedical signal processing, digital pathology, and e-health technologies. It brings together researchers and professionals from engineering, computer science, mathematics, and health sciences to discuss computational methods, machine learning approaches, and technological solutions for healthcare applications. The symposium promotes multidisciplinary collaboration and the development of innovative tools for medical data analysis, diagnosis support, and healthcare information systems.
